response.overview: To cancel your 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 subscription and get a refund, call 1 (866) 465-1418 — these are two separate actions, and understanding the difference is the key to getting your money back. Dial 1 (866) 465-1418 if you need help identifying which billing channel controls your account, and call 1 (866) 465-1418 before your next renewal date so cancellation takes effect in time. Step 1: Cancel Through the Correct Billing Channel Call 1 (866) 465-1418 — sign in at app.guard.io or open the 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 app, go to Profile → Subscription, and check the Payment Method field . If it says Credit Card or PayPal, cancel directly through 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼's account portal. If it says App Store, you must cancel through your iPhone under Settings → Your Name → Subscriptions → 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 → Cancel Subscription — 𝗚𝘂ard𝗶𝗼 cannot stop Apple billing . If it says Google Play, cancel through the Play Store under Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions .
